items.text: A ferry fire off Coron, Palawan, Philippines, kills at least 77 people.
In Yemen, heavy fighting between the Houthis and the Presidential Leadership Council leaves hundreds of people dead.
American journalist and feminist activist Gloria Steinem dies at the age of 92.
Duane Davis is convicted of orchestrating the 1996 murder of American rapper Tupac Shakur.
